scope: P1 repository, provenance and dependency-license audit only

blockers.title: Public-history strategy for personal metadata is undecided
facts: Historic commits and annotated tags expose a personal email address.
Historic patches contain personal absolute user/tool paths.
The current working tree redacts the remaining personal profile reference.
Future commits in this repository use the configured GitHub noreply address.
ownerDecisionRequired: rewrite every intended public branch and tag after a separate private backup and explicit approval
publish a new/squashed sanitized history while retaining the old history privately
blockers.completionEvidence: Documented owner decision plus a fresh all-ref scan of exactly the refs intended for publication

blockers.title: Pre-import provenance and asset rights are not attested
facts: The root commit imports almost the entire application and its assets.
Git therefore cannot prove authorship or tool/source provenance before that commit.
No obvious vendored binary, font or unrelated foreign asset was found in the current tree.
ownerDecisionRequired: list every exception with source and license
replace or remove any item that cannot be cleared
blockers.completionEvidence: Committed owner attestation with no unresolved exception, or replacement/removal evidence for each exception

blockers.title: DMDC acronym collision/searchability risk is undecided
facts: No exact npm, crates.io, winget or combined DPMAregister mark hit was found for the checked exact terms.
DMDC is nevertheless a strongly established acronym, prominently used by the US Defense Manpower Data Center.
The check is not a formal trademark clearance.
ownerDecisionRequired: accept the documented risk and consistently lead with the full name Desktop Mobile Data Center
blockers.completionEvidence: Recorded owner decision; if renamed, updated artifacts and a repeated exact-name conflict check
